item.tib: 'chi med 'gro 'dul khod spungs blo gros thogs med kyi skyes rabs dang 'brel ba'i don gyi rnam thar gdung rabs dang bcas pa rdzogs ldan spin gyi rol mo
item.coloph: ces khod spungs dbra gter chen po'i rnam thar dnga'abrel ba'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus pa 'di ni nyag shod kyi ri nag 'joms pa gnas chen gsang ba yang rdzong gi sgrub sde byang chub gling du lo gsum phyogs gsum du bcad rgyar gnas pa'i skabs su/ rang gi gcung bla ma dam pa nas 'di lta bu rgyas bsdus mtshams ('tshams) pa zhig dgos zhes bskul nas rnam thar thor bu'i rigs dang lo rgyus kyi khungs rnams dpe cha sna tshogs las tshol ba'i grogs mdzad pa la brten nas/ dge sbyor gyi thun gseng 'ga' zhig la ci rigs su bris te spel ba po ni khod spungs kyi rus su dal rten brnyes pa'i btsun pa dbra ston bskal (skal) bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes 'bod pas bgyis pa ste/ gdul bya kun la dad pa'i dmigs rkyen du gyur nas rnam dkar gyi legs tshogs phyogs kun tu 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig/
